terms.conditions: StartUp: $2.99/mo, renews at $17.99/mo. GrowBig: $4.99/mo, renews at $29.99/mo. GoGeek: $7.99/mo, renews at $44.99/mo. Each displayed plan says prepaid for 12 months. These are monthly-equivalent price labels, not a promise of month-to-month payment. Review the selected term and final order.
The plan promotion checked did not publish a calendar end date. An unpublished deadline does not mean the offer is permanent. The 12-month prepayment term is not a promotion-expiry date.
The official hosting-trial article says SiteGround does not offer free trial hosting accounts. Its 30-day shared-hosting money-back guarantee is a refund policy, not free upfront hosting.

The refund policy states a full refund within 30 days of activation for shared hosting and within 14 days for cloud hosting. Submit cancellation through the Client Area; exclusions apply. Do not apply the shared-hosting window to every product.

For refundable services, request cancellation within 30 days of the renewal payment. The policy provides a full refund if the renewal term has not started, or a partial refund less the first month of the renewal term if it has started.

Domain name fees, paid support and third-party services are not covered by the money-back guarantee. Domain fees may remain due on cancellation even if initially waived as a promotion. Check these exclusions before ordering.
